title: The handover page: terms, consent tick box, confirm or reject

namespace Drupal\hwdesk\Form; final class ConfirmHandoverForm extends \Drupal\Core\Form\FormBase (declare(strict_types=1)). getFormId(): 'hwdesk_confirm_handover'. Rewrite of the page behind the link in the e-mail. Two things change. (1) The link itself proves who the visitor is, so nobody has to log in: the old check against the logged-in account is gone. (2) The employee has to tick that they agree with the handover terms, and the text they agreed to is copied onto the handover at that moment, so a later edit of the settings never changes what somebody already signed. Constructor: __construct(protected readonly \Drupal\hwdesk\Service\HandoverService $handovers, protected readonly \Drupal\hwdesk\Service\HandoverTokens $tokens, protected readonly \Drupal\Core\Datetime\DateFormatterInterface $dateFormatter, protected readonly \Drupal\Core\Config\ConfigFactoryInterface $configFactory, protected readonly \Drupal\Component\Datetime\TimeInterface $time). create(ContainerInterface $container): static passes 'hwdesk.handover', 'hwdesk.handover_tokens', 'date.formatter', 'config.factory', 'datetime.time' in that order. buildForm(array $form, FormStateInterface $form_state, string $token = '', ?\Drupal\hwdesk\Entity\Handover $hwdesk_handover = NULL): array -- the parameter names match the two routes and must not be renamed. Entry A, route hwdesk.handover.confirm (path /hvd/{token}, open to anonymous): $token is set. $claims = $this->tokens->verify($token); NULL -> throw new NotFoundHttpException('Odkaz je neplatny nebo vyprsel.') (Symfony\Component\HttpKernel\Exception\NotFoundHttpException). Load the handover from $claims['handover']; not a Handover -> NotFoundHttpException. Do NOT compare anything with the logged-in account: the link is the proof. Entry B, route hwdesk.handover.confirm_own (path /hwdesk/prevzeti/{hwdesk_handover}, logged in): $hwdesk_handover is set and $token is ''. The handover must belong to the current user: (int) $hwdesk_handover->getUser()?->id() !== (int) $this->currentUser()->id() -> throw new AccessDeniedHttpException('Tato vyzva patri jinemu zamestnanci.'). Its status must be \Drupal\hwdesk\HandoverStatus::Pending and its expires must not be in the past (use $this->time->getRequestTime()), otherwise NotFoundHttpException. Nothing is consumed on this route, so the link in the e-mail stays valid. Neither given (both empty) -> NotFoundHttpException. Y H:i'). The terms text: read config 'hwdesk.settings' through $this->configFactory->get(). uses.HandoverService: web/modules/hwdesk/src/Service/HandoverService.php: confirm(Handover $handover, AccountInterface $actor): Handover and reject(Handover $handover, AccountInterface $actor, string $reason): Handover -- both throw \DomainException when the handover is not pending or when $actor is not the handover's employee, reject() throws \InvalidArgumentException on an empty reason

database: Only through the entities and services above; no direct SQL.
forbidden: Any check of the visitor's account on the /hvd/{token} route: the whole point is that the employee does not have to log in.
Storing the terms text after confirm() has run, or not storing it at all: the protocol prints what was agreed.
Spending the link when the submit failed, or spending it on the logged-in route.
Writing the routing file, the service file or the test.
